import pytest
from testcontainers.compose import DockerCompose

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def services():
    """They all have to dance together. Or they all fall down."""
    with DockerCompose(".", compose_file_name="docker-compose.test.yml") as compose:
        compose.wait_for("http://localhost:8080/health")
        yield compose

@pytest.fixture
def isolated_order(db_session):
    """Each test lives in its own bubble. Safe. Contained."""
    order = create_test_order(unique_id=uuid4())
    yield order
    db_session.rollback()  # The universe resets

class TestHappyPath:
    """When everything works. So rare. So beautiful."""
    
    def test_complete_order_flow(self, services, isolated_order):
        # The dance begins
        response = order_service.submit(isolated_order)
        
        # Wait for the whispers between services
        await_event("inventory.reserved", timeout=5)
        await_event("payment.processed", timeout=10)
        await_event("notification.sent", timeout=3)
        
        assert response.status == "CONFIRMED"
        assert inventory_service.get_reserved(isolated_order.item_id) > 0
        assert notification_service.was_sent(isolated_order.customer_email)

class TestServiceFailures:
    """I can see where they break. Every fracture point."""
    
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("failing_service,expected_compensation", [
        ("inventory", None),  # Nothing to undo yet
        ("payment", "inventory.unreserved"),
        ("notification", "payment.refunded,inventory.unreserved"),
    ])
    def test_failure_triggers_compensation(self, services, failing_service, expected_compensation):
        with service_chaos(failing_service, error_rate=1.0):
            response = order_service.submit(isolated_order)
        
        assert response.status == "FAILED"
        if expected_compensation:
            for event in expected_compensation.split(","):
                assert_event_occurred(event)

class TestTimeoutBehavior:
    """Time... it doesn't move the same for everyone."""
    
    def test_payment_timeout_triggers_retry_then_compensation(self, services):
        with service_latency("payment", delay_ms=15000):
            response = order_service.submit(isolated_order)
        
        assert count_events("payment.attempted") == 3  # Retries
        assert_event_occurred("inventory.unreserved")

class TestAsyncMessaging:
    """Messages in bottles, floating through the void."""
    
    def test_duplicate_messages_are_idempotent(self, services):
        publish_event("order.submitted", isolated_order, times=3)
        
        await_stability(duration=2)
        assert inventory_service.reservation_count(isolated_order.id) == 1
